principles: Explain study intent with facts, not emotion.
Avoid unsupported claims about funds, work, or future plans.
Keep the document concise unless the prompt requires more detail.

banned_phrases: I plan to stay in Canada permanently
This is my route to citizenship
Any school in Canada is fine
I chose Canada for easy visa approval
My sponsor will manage everything without proof
at the end of the day

preferred_replacements.I want PR: I plan to use this education to build my career after graduation.
preferred_replacements.any school in Canada is fine: This institution best matches my academic and career goals.
preferred_replacements.easy visa approval: Canada offers a program structure that aligns with my study plan.
